objective: Compare AIAS structural outputs against independent, reviewed and integrity-protected reference evidence before professional release consideration.
requirements: Every benchmark records identity, version, domain, source organization, source locator and method.
Independence from the AIAS implementation must be explicitly established.
Every metric declares units and absolute and relative tolerances.
Missing, non-finite, unexpected or out-of-tolerance results fail closed.
Benchmark and validation evidence have deterministic SHA-256 identities.
Passing SCP-08 never independently authorizes construction or professional release.
external_completion_conditions: Obtain authorized independent benchmark datasets for each normative material and analysis domain.
Record qualified reviewer acceptance and evidence locator.
Execute the governed validation campaign using the exact production solver and code-pack versions.
